name: RPWS Taxonomy Filter Lite
author: Rodrigo Salles

sections.description:
Transform your Elementor Pro filtering experience with Taxonomy Filter Lite – a free widget that provides professional dropdown filtering for your Loop Grid.

Free Features:
✓ Dropdown filtering with placeholder support
✓ Hierarchy display with customizable depth
✓ Smart Loop Grid integration
✓ Bookmarkable filtered states
✓ Custom dropdown icon support
✓ Full styling controls
✓ Empty terms control options

Want More Display Types?
Upgrade to Taxonomy Filter Plus to unlock:
• Multi-Select dropdowns
• Interactive Buttons
• Checkboxes
• Radio Buttons
• Clear Selection buttons
• Advanced layout controls
• And more premium features!

Requirements:
WordPress 5.0+, PHP 7.4+, Elementor 3.0+, and Elementor Pro (or Pro Elements) for Loop Grid functionality.

For more information, visit evolutionwidgetsplus.com.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. In Elementor editor, find “Taxonomy Filter Lite” in the General category
  6. Add it to your page with a Loop Grid widget and start filtering!
sections.faq:
Does this work without Elementor Pro?

No, this widget requires Elementor Pro (or Pro Elements) for the Loop Grid functionality.

Can I filter multiple taxonomies at once?

Each widget filters one taxonomy. For multiple taxonomies, add multiple filter widgets to your page.

Does it support custom post types and taxonomies?

Yes! It automatically detects all registered post types and their taxonomies.

Are filtered states bookmarkable?

Yes! Filter selections are stored in URL parameters, making them bookmarkable and shareable.

How can I get more display types?

Upgrade to Taxonomy Filter Plus to unlock Multi-Select, Buttons, Checkboxes, and Radio Button display types!

  • Empty terms control options

  • Dropdown icon customization
